paper_metadata.title: Coarsening behavior of γ′ precipitates of single crystal Ni-based superalloys during long-term exposure

evidence.quote: The phase stability of γ′ precipitates in single crystal Ni-based superalloys at the elevated temperature is inherently associated with creep performance.
